_about: GENERATED by docs/plan/tools/class_tree.js — do not edit; edit docs/plan/tools/class_tree_manual.json and run the tool. Every High Five class: parent / children / race / tier / change level / role / names. Used by the class plan gate (Scripts_dev/swarm.js CLASSPLAN-PURE) and the dashboard Classes page.

sources.tree: Scripts/data/dp/classSkillTree.xml (L2J High Five datapack, github.com/Shagooh/l2j-server-datapack): classId + parentClassId
sources.levels: L2J High Five ClassLevel: 1st profession at level 20, 2nd at 40, 3rd at 76. Confirmed on L2Toggle: the board's Career -> Professions page says 'To get a new profession you must obtain 20 / 40 / 76 level' (Logs/career_*.html).
sources.fee: L2Toggle Career -> Professions page: 'The cost of changing the profession: 200 000' adena (Logs/career_Dagger1.html, 2026-10-09).
sources.roots: Base classes (no parent in classSkillTree.xml) with their race / fighter-mystic / gender: L2J ClassId (Race, isMage) for the 11 base classes.
sources.roles: General High Five class knowledge (what the class is played for); swarmRoles = the swarm.js role keys (swarm.config.json accounts[].role) a class suits.
sources.aliases: Labels seen on the L2Toggle Professions page (Logs/career_*.html: 'Human Wizard', 'Sorcerer', 'Soul Breaker', ...) and the names the old CONFIG.classPlan used ('Wizard', 'Dark Wizard', 'Scavenger', 'Artisan', "Eva's Saint").
sources.subclassOnly: Retail High Five: Inspector / Judicator are taken as a SUBCLASS (a Kamael with two subclasses); the datapack lists Inspector under Warder. The class plan picker shows them with a warning; verify on the Career page.
sources.roleSuggestions: The role -> class path defaults swarm.js used until 2026-10-10 (ROLE_CLASS_PLAN + the old CONFIG.classPlan). Suggestions ONLY: a suggestion is never approved by itself.
